(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD) Learned AGA accepts notice for respondent No.2.
2.

This appeal is filed by the beneficiary of acquisition under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act', for short) challenging the judgment and award dated 15.12.2022 and 02.01.2023 respectively passed in L.A.C. No.41/2018 by the learned II Addl. District and Sessions and Special Judge, Dharwad, whereby the Reference Court fixed market value of the acquired land at the rate of Rs.5,30,000/- per acre.
3.

4. In view of the judgment of co-ordinate Bench of this Court in M.F.A. No.102543/2022, disposed off on 23.09.2024, the present appeal is not maintainable.

Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed in terms of judgment of this Court in M.F.A.
No.102543/2022, dated 23.09.2024.

Sd/-
